object.title: The Chang–Hsu–Rogers rainbow embedding conjecture
object.statement:
Let $G$ be an abelian group, and let $K_G$ be the complete graph on vertex set $G$, with each edge $xy$ coloured by $x+y$. A copy is **rainbow** when all its edge colours are distinct.

**Chang–Hsu–Rogers conjecture.** For every $n$-vertex tree $T$, the edge-coloured graph $K_{\mathbb{Z}_n}$ contains a rainbow copy of $T$.

This stronger rainbow-embedding formulation would imply the harmonious labelling conjecture. The paper confirms it for bounded-degree trees, while the general case remains open.
object.source_name: Alp Müyesser and Alexey Pokrovskiy, “On the Graham–Sloane harmonious labelling conjecture”, arXiv:2509.05280 (2025).
object.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.05280

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2025).

object.title: Layer-one extremal conjecture for the isolation lemma
object.literal_statement:
Let $H$ be a hypergraph on vertex set $[n]$, let $M$ be a positive integer, and let $f$ be an objective function. For a weight $w$, define its layer by

$$
L(w)=\min_{x\in[n]}w(x).
$$

Let $Z_1(H,M,f)$ be the set of isolating weights whose layer is $1$, and let $Y_1(M,n)$ denote the universal lower bound on $|Z_1(H,M,f)|$.

**Layer-one extremal conjecture.**

$$
Y_1(M,n)=n(M-1)^{n-1}
$$

This is the conjectured tight bound for isolating weights whose minimum vertex weight is $1$; it is attained by the singleton hypergraph.

object.title: Ossona de Mendez–Oum–Wood defective colouring conjecture
object.statement:
For a graph class $\mathcal{G}$, let $\chi_{\Delta}(\mathcal{G})$ be the minimum integer $k$ such that, for some integer $d$, every graph in $\mathcal{G}$ is $k$-colourable with defect $d$. For a graph $H$, let $\mathcal{M}_H$ be the class of $H$-minor-free graphs, and let $\operatorname{\overline{td}}(H)$ denote the connected tree-depth of $H$. **Ossona de Mendez–Oum–Wood's conjecture.** For every graph $H$, 
$$
\chi_{\Delta}(\mathcal{M}_H)=\operatorname{\overline{td}}(H)-1.
$$
 The conjecture is a defective-colouring analogue of Hadwiger's conjecture. The lower bound is proved, and the upper bound is known when $\operatorname{\overline{td}}(H)\leqslant 3$, when $H$ is complete bipartite, and when $H=K_t$; the general upper bound remains open.
